allow: Bash(osascript -e 'tell application "Safari" to activate' -e 'tell application "Safari" to open location "http://localhost:3001"')
Bash(osascript -e 'tell application "Safari" to name of every document')

Bash(osascript -e 'tell application "Safari" to activate' -e 'tell application "Safari" to set URL of front document to "http://localhost:3001"' -e 'tell application "Safari" to set bounds of front window to {40, 40, 400, 900}' -e 'tell application "Safari" to get bounds of front window')
Bash(osascript -e 'tell application "Safari" to get URL of front document')
Bash(osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to UI elements enabled')

Bash(swift -e 'import Cocoa; let point = CGPoint\(x: 360, y: 110\); let src = CGEventSource\(stateID: .combinedSessionState\); let down = CGEvent\(mouseEventSource: src, mouseType: .leftMouseDown, mouseCursorPosition: point, mouseButton: .left\); let up = CGEvent\(mouseEventSource: src, mouseType: .leftMouseUp, mouseCursorPosition: point, mouseButton: .left\); down?.post\(tap: .cghidEventTap\); up?.post\(tap: .cghidEventTap\); usleep\(300000\)')
